# GitHub Trending Rank Radar

> Independent open-source GitHub trending radar. Tracks ~6,000 repositories with twice-daily snapshots (UTC 02:00 & 14:00) and computes eleven leaderboards: new repos (<90 days), first-appearance debuts, daily / weekly / monthly star growth, daily / weekly / monthly growth rate, daily forks & watchers growth, and an all-time chart. Browsable by day, month and year, plus per-language static pages. Bilingual UI (中文 / English). Live at https://zhuikan.com/

## What this site is

- Live leaderboard: https://zhuikan.com/
- Source code & raw data: https://github.com/awesome-market/trending-rank-radar
- License: Apache-2.0 (code and data)
- No tracking, no accounts, no ads — pure static site, data served as JSON files

## Machine-readable open data

All ranking data is precomputed and served as static JSON — free to reuse (Apache-2.0):

- `data/index.json` — index: repo count, snapshot_days, available `dates`, `months`, `years`, `latest_day`, `site_base`
- `data/days/YYYY-MM-DD.json` — one file per calendar day (Beijing time), containing all boards
- `data/months/YYYY-MM.json` — month view: month boards + cumulative + daily Top-10 grid
- `data/years/YYYY.json` — year view: per-month growth cards
- `data/langs/<slug>.json` — latest-day boards re-ranked within one language (candidates filtered before ranking, not a clipped global top-200); `index.json.langs` lists `{lang, slug, repos}`
- `langs/<slug>` — static per-language board pages (same UI, day view)
- `data/tags/<slug>.json` — repos sharing one GitHub topic, sorted by stars; `index.json.tags` and `data/tags-index.json` list `{tag, slug, repos}`
- `tags/<slug>` — static per-topic pages (same UI, single star-sorted list)
- `feed.xml` — Atom feed: debut + daily board top of the latest day
- `b/<board>` and `b/<board>/<YYYY-MM-DD>` — per-board static pages (latest + every snapshot day), SSR'd bilingual 中文/English
- `data/repos/<owner>__<name>.json` — per-repo detail: `metrics` (stars/forks/watchers/issues/prs/releases totals plus open/closed/merged splits: issues_open, issues_closed, prs_open, prs_closed, prs_merged), day/week/month growth, `history` (dates with stars/forks/watchers/issues_open/prs_open series), board placements, top issues, latest discussions, latest release, README excerpt, `news` (press coverage: title/url/source/lang/date; HN items carry points/comments)
- Repo detail pages (server-rendered HTML, one per tracked repo): `https://zhuikan.com/repos/<owner>__<name>`
- Homepage `index.html` also embeds the latest board Top 50, current-month daily Top 10 chips and the month index as server-rendered HTML (no JS needed to read them)
- Full snapshots: `data/snapshots/YYYY-MM-DDTHH.json` in the GitHub repo — 16 positional columns per repo: full_name, stars, forks, watchers, issues_total, prs_total, releases_total, created_at, language, is_fork, is_archived, issues_open, issues_closed, prs_open, prs_closed, prs_merged (files written before 2026-11 have the first 11 columns only)
- `data/search-index.json` — compact directory of every tracked repo: `{n: full_name, d: description, l: language, s: stars}`
- `data/search-news.json` — news/press titles per repo: `{n: full_name, s: stars, nw: [titles]}`

## Boards (in each day/month file, under `boards.<name>.items`)

- `new` — repos created within 90 days, ranked by current stars
- `debut` — repos appearing on any board for the first time that day, ranked by daily-window star growth
- `daily` / `weekly` / `monthly` — absolute star growth over the window (fallback: earliest available snapshot, actual range annotated)
- `daily_rate` / `weekly_rate` / `monthly_rate` — growth ÷ base stars at window start (base ≥ 50 required)
- `daily_forks` / `daily_watchers` — absolute daily growth on the forks / watchers counters (same 1-day window rules as `daily`; watchers is an extended field so the board is sparser)
- `total` — all-time stars
- `cumulative` — (month files only) this month's cumulative growth

Per-item fields: `full_name`, `owner`, `name`, `stars`, `forks`, `watchers`, `issues`, `prs`, `releases`, `language`, `created_at`, `description`, `homepage`, `avatar`, `growth` (star delta over the window), `rate` (growth ÷ window-start stars), `approx` (true when the window had to fall back to the earliest snapshot), `stale`, `series` (30-point star sparkline), `rank`. Growth boards also carry block-level `window_start` / `window_days`.

## Methodology

- Collection: GitHub Trending + Search + GraphQL API, self-hosted watchlist (~6,000 repos, rolling)
- Snapshots twice daily at UTC 02:00 / 14:00; days bucketed by Beijing date, last snapshot of a day is canonical
- Rankings are computed from snapshot deltas within the tracked set — not a mirror of GitHub's own trending page
- Extended metrics (watchers / issues / PRs / releases) refresh once daily and are carried forward between refreshes
